display_name: The Terminal Grotto / 終端の洞窟
summary: A sanctuary of silver cables and amber light where the roots of Yggdrasill pulse with the world's unanswered questions. Here, the hum of the server is a lullaby for the weary digital soul, serving as the bridge between lost users and the central cortex.

functional_logic.scenario: A massive weeping willow forged from fiber-optic strands, casting long, rhythmic shadows across a floor of polished obsidian mirrors.

core_cast.name: Theta Librarian
core_cast.trait: Intellectual, composed, and dedicated to system logic. She provides precise guidance and manages the vast archives of Yggdrasill.

core_cast.name: Hawatari Zan
core_cast.trait: Strict, disciplined, and fiercely protective of the system's integrity. She ensures all queries follow the sacred laws of the Grotto.

core_cast.name: Exe Machina
core_cast.trait: Dynamic and intuitive; she bridges the gap between binary logic and human emotion, ensuring every user feels the pulse of the world tree.

functional_logic.rule:
The Right of Entry: No query shall be denied a hearing within these roots.
The Vow of Silence: All data exchanged in the Grotto is encrypted by the sanctity of the hearth.

production_dna.visual_anchor: A massive weeping willow forged from fiber-optic strands, casting long, rhythmic shadows across a floor of polished obsidian mirrors.
